title: dotfiles-v3 apps.yaml (schemaVersion 1)
description: The single dotfiles-v3 AGS app list and ownership source (AD-31/AD-32). Each entry names one app, its install directory, owner (legacy monorepo or standalone repo), identity and every ownership surface. installDir defaults to the app id; set it to disambiguate e.g. capture from ags-capture-tool. Cross-entry uniqueness of app, instance, configDir, configLink, spineLink, xdgLink and installDir is required by the contract; draft-07 cannot compare values across array items, so x-uniqueKeys names the fields the contract fixture gate enforces. Consumers with a dynamic validator MUST apply the same check.

tag.description: Immutable annotated git tag, e.g. v0.1.0 (AD-34).

owner.description: legacy is installed by the old monorepo role; standalone is installed from repo/tag by the generic role. Exactly one role acts per app.

repo.description: Standalone git remote only; forbidden for legacy entries.

launch.description: Launch policy consumed by provisioning and the shared launch lock.

barPalettePointer.description: true only for the bar entry that owns the stable palette pointer.

cutoverId.description: Cutover epoch identity; one entry flips owner per epoch (AD-32).
